analysis.title: The 720: China Internet, NVDA, Anta Sports & Amer Sports, JD Group, MUFG, Asics, Shiseido, Hesai, Miniso, HBM tracker
key_insights: GS's initial take on the US BIS interim final rule on remote access to advanced chips: frontier training is the most exposed, while inference and applications stay largely resilient on domestic chips. Impact depends on the share of a company's rented compute located outside China versus inside.

Among China cloud hyperscalers, GS sees vertically integrated internet giants as better positioned as the scarcity value of installed compliant fleets rises. Z.AI is relatively resilient because nearly all of its rented training compute is in Mainland China. Offshore GPU-cloud intermediaries and Southeast Asian operators serving China face the most severe effects from the new destination licensing requirements.

Nvidia 3Q revenue was $115.8 bn versus GS $110.1 bn and Street $109.5 bn. Data Center revenue was $107.6 bn and operating EPS was $2.68, both above GS and the Street. Guidance for 4Q revenue is $130 bn at the midpoint versus GS and Street at $124.8 bn. Implied 4Q non-GAAP EPS of $2.81 is below GS at $2.88 but above the Street at $2.67.

GS expects Nvidia to trade modestly higher against neutral-to-negative investor positioning. The stock reaction will depend on call disclosures on CEO succession, the FY28 revenue growth outlook of about 70% YoY, and AI datacenter deployments. GS says 4Q guidance supports its digital semiconductor coverage: Broadcom, AMD, Marvell, ARM and Intel.

Amer Sports 3Q26 adjusted EPS was $0.42 and revenue was $2.17bn, above GS and consensus. Revenue growth was 23.5% YoY and adjusted gross margin rose 150bps YoY to 59.4%. FY26 guidance was raised to adjusted EPS of $1.32-$1.35 and revenue growth of 25%-26%. Management gave an initial FY27 framework of LDD% to mid-teens revenue growth and announced an open-ended buyback of up to $1bn.

Anta Sports: GS sees a positive read-across from Amer, whose Greater China revenue grew 30.4% YoY with strength in Arc'teryx and Salomon. Anta's 3Q26 was resilient despite a weak China macro backdrop. Buy, 12m TP HK$105.

JD 3Q26 adjusted net profit rose 44% YoY to Rmb8.3bn, 4% above GS. Group revenue growth recovered to 4% YoY. Jingdong Industrials revenue was Rmb8.0bn, up 36% YoY, a beat. JD Logistics revenue was Rmb64.0bn, in line, with a 4% beat in external integrated supply chain revenue.

Miniso 3Q26 sales and adjusted net profit beat GS by 4% and 12%. FY26 guidance was unchanged because of caution on overseas volatility and elevated distributor inventory. GS raised 12m TPs to US$16/HK$31.12 and trimmed 2026E-28E adjusted net profit estimates by up to 4%. Management expects group margins to trough in 2026.

Tencent Music 3Q26 was mixed but better than feared. GS raised 12m TPs to US$12.2/HK$48, expects a 50% YoY acceleration in IP-related business in 4Q26 and sees an estimated 2026 shareholder yield above 9%. Organic subscriptions remain under pressure and advertising faces macro headwinds.

MUFG 1H27: management has no plans to raise its deposit beta and sees strong domestic loan demand. GS thinks further rate hikes could keep lifting net interest income. The FY27 total payout ratio is 51%, and management expects FY28 returns to better match profit.

Asics Investment Day: the plan targets FY29 sales of ¥1.5 tn, an 80% total shareholder return ratio, ¥400 bn of cumulative returns and 50% ROE. FY27-FY29 sales CAGR targets are 10% North America, 12% performance running, 16% SportStyle and 10% Onitsuka Tiger.

Taiwan ODMs: AI servers continue to drive 4Q26 revenue while PCs stay weak on high memory cost and material shortage. GS cut 12m TPs for Asus, Quanta and Pegatron and cut FY26-FY28E earnings for Quanta, Pegatron and Compal by 3-20%.

Shiseido is selling its China Aupres subsidiary, which had FY25 sales of ¥18.1 bn and an operating loss of ¥1.2 bn. The sale is already in FY26 guidance, and GS expects core operating margin to rise as losses shrink.

Korea HBM tracker: consensus for SK Hynix HBM ASP and shipments has risen substantially. DDR5 spot pricing is 110% and 83% above GS's 4Q26 HBM and conventional DRAM ASP estimates. GS's Samsung HBM ASP estimates are 19% and 7% above consensus for 2027 and 2028. SK Hynix 2028 consensus ASP is $3.8/Gb versus GS at $3.0/Gb.

Hesai: robotics was over 50% of 3Q26 revenue, and GS forecasts 62% by 2030E. LiDAR segment EBIT margin reached 15.8% in 3Q26. GS models 2027E revenue growth of 39% and non-GAAP EBIT growth of 145%, with robotics actuation module shipments rising to six digits from 23k in 3Q26.
China medtech: GS sees a cleaner 2027 setup as channel destocking nears completion. Equipment bidding improved to 12% YoY in October. Preferred names are Mindray, SNIBE and AngelAlign.

GS EM Outlook 2027: MSCI EM end-2027 target of 1,850 (19% higher) on profit growth of 26%. India, China and Mexico are upgraded to OW and Taiwan and Brazil cut to MW. GS forecasts 10% total returns in local rates and sovereign credit spreads widening 40 bps to 240 bps.

Nike Investor Day: FY31 framework of about $5bn incremental revenue versus the FY27 base, a 12% to 14% adjusted operating margin and adjusted EPS of $3.00 to $3.50. FY27 guidance is reaffirmed at a high-single-digit revenue decline and about a 6% adjusted operating margin. GS stays Neutral with a 12m TP of $30.
